title: Cancellation property
text: You can apply cancellation: $$\frac{ab}{ac}=\frac{b}{c}$$ when a\neq $$0$$

title: Common factor
text: We can cancel the common factor of $$x$$ from numerator and denominator when x\neq $$0$$. These means that when x\neq $$0$$ the two expressions are equivalent! However, when $$x=0$$, the expression $$\frac{x^2}{x}$$ is undefined.
